row_check.notes: ca_measure empty is correct: no competitive-advantage construct appears anywhere in the paper. quality_notes ('Unusual outcome (volatility) - valuable nuance') is coder commentary but anchored by the paper's own first-to-study-volatility claim (p. 2 quote) and correlational caveat (p. 14). On direction: the paper does report a significant average AI-volatility association (~6-10%), but volatility is not a signed performance level, and the sourcing split shows the association exists only for AI buyers (developers null) and is neutralized by ICT human capital - consistent with the final 'conditional' coding; no tension flagged.
